gui_forms::ComboBox.summary: ComboBox is a retained noneditable choice field with authoritative item selection, placeholder projection, keyboard cycling, a source-private transient ListBox, bounded item count, independent overlay width, focus-safe lifetime handling, and option semantics.
remarks: A noneditable choice field. Item selection is authoritative; placeholder text is projected when nothing is selected; keyboard cycling changes the selection without opening the overlay.
The drop-down list is a source-private transient `ListBox` with an independently bounded overlay width and item count.
gui_forms::ComboBox.ownership: Created by the application as a `Control::Ptr` (`std::shared_ptr<Control>`). A parent holds its children strongly and a child holds its parent weakly; cycles, duplicate stable IDs, cross-window reparenting, and disposed children are rejected. Disposal through `Component::dispose()` is synchronous and idempotent and revokes owned subscriptions before subclass teardown.
gui_forms::ComboBox.threading: UI-thread affine. Read and mutate on the owning Window's UI thread; wrong-thread mutation is rejected by the Window access guards (`Window::check_access` and `Window::verify_access`). The type is not internally synchronized.
gui_forms::ComboBox.availability: Renderer-neutral core (`gui_forms_controls`). Available wherever the GUI.Forms core builds: the macOS AppKit host, the Windows Win32 host, and the opt-in Linux X11 host. The public API is not yet stable.
